title: Italian-Style Potato Wrap
description: A simple and delicious Italian-inspired wrap filled with roasted potatoes, sweet vegetables, and a hint of Algerian spices.
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with Algerian spices.
Toss the potatoes to coat evenly and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
While the potatoes are roasting, slice the sweet onions into thin rings.
Melt the quenched cheese in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the pan and sauté until softened.
Warm the wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the cheese and onion mixture on the wrap, then topping with roasted potatoes.
